text: What is something you keep telling yourself you'll deal with later? What happens when you imagine dealing with it now?
Think of the last time you held back from saying something to someone close to you. What did you leave unsaid, and what stopped you?
When something you made doesn't go well, what are the first words you say to yourself about it?
What kind of situation do you keep ending up in, even after telling yourself next time would be different?
What is something you want that you rarely admit to wanting? What makes it hard to say out loud?
Which message, email or call have you left unanswered the longest? What do you expect to happen when you reply?
Who do you act most differently around, compared with how you are on your own? What changes?
When someone praises your work, what do you say to yourself right after?
What argument have you had more than once, with different people? What part did you play each time?
If nobody would ever find out how you spent it, what would you do with a free month?
What did you last start and then put down as soon as it got uncomfortable? Which part was uncomfortable?
When did you last feel let down by someone and not tell them? What did you do with that feeling?
What do you tell yourself on a morning when you have more to do than you can finish?
What promise do you make to yourself most often? What usually happens in the week after you make it?
